correctness.rationale: The six base centers A={0,1,4,10,12,17} and B={0,1,8,11,13,17} have identical 36 ordered signed differences: nonzero positive distances are exactly 1..13,16,17 once each. With H_m={22k:0<=k<m}, the disjoint center blocks form convolution measures, preserving the entire signed autocorrelation for every integer m>=1. Initial radius-1/4 disks do not overlap, so their indicators equal delta-center convolution with the disk indicator; convolution with reflection therefore gives identical full planar covariograms and independent pair-displacement laws. Dilation by r turns them into disks radius R=r+1/4, and for 11/4<r<13/4 the center contact threshold 2R lies strictly between 6 and 7. A has within-block gaps (1,3,6,2,5) and block gap 5: all connected; B has gaps (1,7,3,2,4) and block gap 5: exactly one separating 7-gap in each of m blocks, giving m+1 components. An independent difference-counter and gap-counter check confirmed m=1,2,3,10,30. The all-m proof is exact convolution and ordered-gap reasoning; 6m original components bound the growth order.
